gt_provenance.details: 1032 protocol records exactly match bound filename-derived dataset labels; fold identities are disjoint, all 248 training rows are source-only. Access zero is supported by recorded rows and inspected control flow, not an OS-level I/O trace.

score_normalization.details: Cross-scene Smooth-AP uses fixed tau=0.01 and eligible-anchor mean over full valid candidate ranks. No division by prediction extrema. Overfit ratio uses analytic label-smoothing CE floor and initial excess; raw losses are retained. Gradient-relative errors are numerical checks, not retrieval metrics.

result_existence.details: All 28 intake files, original stage exits, all 45 CPU-bound artifacts, 8 optimizer states and 6 capacity checkpoints verified. Current execution source/config hashes match. The tracker header/table still says NOT_RUN despite its later completion milestone; no numerical phantom result found.

dead_code.details: The task-state runner calls T0, M0 and M0_CPU and the executed training path calls current and history gradients, direct auxiliary gradients, optimizer step, disk state serialization and engineering gates. Retrieval is intentionally excluded from M0; inherited EMA controller and its verifier are unused by this task-state method.

scope.details: One dataset, one seed, three capacity fold pairs and one fold-0 fixed-batch overfit pair. No real unsupported ranking batch occurred. No held-out retrieval is established by M0; full gradient/update-vector/trajectory reconstruction is unavailable.

eval_type.details: Dataset labels supervise actual M0 model checks. Toy arithmetic and standalone-Signal parity are separately labeled and do not establish retrieval quality. No M0 human evaluation or official/held-out retrieval result.

limitations.details: Zero real M0 absent-ranking steps. Absent support, old-momentum suppression, and supported-zero behavior have synthetic and source-code coverage only; they are not empirically established for a real unsupported M0 batch.

Saved scalar gradient/moment/update norms, pair cosines, final states and one direct-reference step per capacity endpoint do not reconstruct the 248-step parameter-gradient trajectory or per-task preconditioned update vectors.

actual_parameter_updates stores norm(theta_before), norm(theta_after), norm(delta_theta), and cosine(theta_before,theta_after); it does not save an update-direction cosine to R/A or a cross-arm update vector. The plan language about update directions must be qualified.

Split treatment begins during warmup and sums separately preconditioned directions. First-step role update norms are 1.646989 to 1.724274 times control. A pure state-history, scale-controlled, or post-warmup-only causal claim is unsupported.

Matched initialization and source pixel hashes hold, but Mamba first-step gradient summaries are not bitwise equal across arms. Maximum observed absolute gradient-summary scalar difference is 4.0325888398760066e-7; cause was not diagnosed and cross-arm gradient-vector equality is not established.

Audit performed zero model forwards, optimizer updates or image reads. Model/optimizer/distance binaries remained remote. Dataset image contents, original per-step gradients, RNG byte states, and live process I/O were not re-executed or independently traced.

Six capacity model checkpoints reconstruct exactly. Overfit model checkpoints are not saved; their final model and frozen-state equality remain runtime witnesses, while final optimizer/scaler states were independently read and checked.
Fresh independent context, same-family/provisional semantic review. gpt-6-astra and max are requested route attribution; actual backend model identity and reasoning execution are unattested.

Historical NOT_RUN/current-state wording remains in the tracker top table. The dated final milestone and original pipeline receipts establish completion. The pinned preregistration plan must retain its original bytes.
